title: Washington Apple Health for Adults renewal input

renewal_month.description: The month their coverage renews, like "2027-03". On their renewal letter, or at wahealthplanfinder.org.

has_medicare.description: Whether they have Medicare Part A or Part B.

expected_unborn_children.description: If pregnant, how many babies they're expecting.

expects_to_file_taxes.description: Whether they expect to file a federal tax return for this year.

expects_to_be_claimed_as_dependent.description: Whether they expect someone else to claim them as a tax dependent this year.

claimed_by_parent.description: If someone claims them as a tax dependent: whether that person is their parent, including a stepparent or adoptive parent.

claimed_by_noncustodial_parent.description: If a parent claims them: whether that parent is a noncustodial parent (one they don't live with most of the time).

lives_with_both_parents.description: Only for someone under 19: whether they live with both parents.

parents_file_jointly.description: Only for someone under 19 who lives with both parents: whether their parents file a joint tax return.

required_to_file_taxes.description: If they're a tax dependent: whether their own income is high enough that they're required to file a tax return.

in_medical_institution_30_days.description: Whether they've lived in a hospital, nursing facility, or inpatient psychiatric facility for 30 days in a row, or are expected to.

immigration_status.description: Their citizenship or immigration status. Use other_lawful_status for refugees, asylees, parolees, and other lawful statuses that haven't become permanent residence.

became_lpr_on.description: For lawful permanent residents: the date they became one, like "2022-05-10". On their green card.

lpr_prior_status.description: For lawful permanent residents: the status they had before, if it's one of these; otherwise "none".

armed_forces_connection.description: Whether they're an active-duty service member or honorably discharged veteran, or the spouse or child of one.

lives_in_washington.description: Whether they live in Washington and plan to stay.

has_ssn_or_applied_for_one.description: Whether they have a Social Security number or have applied for one.

enrolled_in_ssi_foster_care_or_adoption_.description: Whether they already get Apple Health through SSI, foster care, or adoption support.

parent_or_caretaker_relative_of_dependen.description: Whether they're the parent or caretaker relative of a child who lives with them and depends on them.

renewer.description: About the person renewing. Always send, as {} if nothing is known.

relationship_to_renewer.description: How this person is related to the renewer.

lives_with_renewer.description: Whether this person lives with the renewer.

claimed_as_dependent_by_renewer.description: Whether the renewer expects to claim this person as a tax dependent.

claims_renewer_as_dependent.description: Whether this person expects to claim the renewer as a tax dependent.

lives_with_renewers_claimer_as_spouse.description: Whether this person is married to and lives with whoever claims the renewer as a tax dependent.

claimed_by_renewers_claimer.description: Whether whoever claims the renewer as a tax dependent also claims this person.

pregnant.description: Whether this person is pregnant now.

expected_unborn_children.description: If pregnant, how many babies they're expecting.

required_to_file_taxes.description: For a child or tax dependent: whether their own income is high enough that they're required to file a tax return.

items.description: One person, described in relation to the renewer.

household_members.description: Other people who might be in their household for Apple Health. Include everyone they live with, and anyone who claims them as a tax dependent or whom that person claims, even if they live elsewhere. [] means nobody else. Leave this out until you've asked.

household_member.description: Whose income it is: the index of the person in household_members. Leave out for the renewer's own income.

type.description: What kind of income. Use educational_benefit_for_education_expenses for grants, loans, and scholarships spent on school; scholarship_for_living_expenses when spent on living costs.

amount_cents.description: The amount before taxes, in cents, as paid at the frequency given. Net earnings for self-employment.

frequency.description: How often it's paid. one_time for a single payment or lump sum that month.

income_items.description: Each source of income anyone in the household had that month. [] means no income.

work_hours.description: Hours the renewer worked that month, paid or unpaid, including work in exchange for things like rent.

work_program_hours.description: Hours in a job training or work program that month.

community_service_hours.description: Hours of community service that month, with a structured program like a food bank, school, or library. Court-ordered counts; political activity doesn't.

education_program_hours.description: If in school less than half-time and the school doesn't use credits: hours in class or other school activities that month.

credit_hours.description: If in school less than half-time and the school uses credits: how many credit hours, 0 to 6.

doesnt_know_work_hours.description: true if the renewer can't say how many hours they worked. Then hours are worked out from their pay.

in_education_program.description: Whether the renewer was enrolled in school or a training program that month.

enrolled_at_least_half_time.description: If in school: whether their school considers them at least half-time.

school_uses_credit_hours.description: If in school less than half-time: whether the school uses credit hours.

months.description: Income and activities, one entry per month. Needs the renewal month (for the income limit) and each of the 6 months before it (for the work requirement). Leave this out until you have at least one month.

is_american_indian_alaska_native.description: Whether they're American Indian or Alaska Native.

is_former_foster_youth.description: Whether they were in foster care.

within_12_months_postpartum.description: Whether they gave birth or had a pregnancy end within the last 12 months.

cares_for_child_under_14.description: Whether they're a parent, guardian, or caretaker of a child 13 or younger.

cares_for_person_with_disability.description: Whether they're a parent, guardian, caretaker, or family caregiver of someone with a disability.

is_veteran_with_total_disability.description: Whether they're a veteran with a total (100%) disability rating, or paid at the 100% rate.

is_medically_frail.description: Whether a disability or health condition makes it very hard for them to work: for example a substance use disorder, a serious mental illness, a condition that limits daily activities, or blindness.

meets_snap_work_requirements.description: Whether they get Basic Food (SNAP), have to meet its work requirements, and are meeting them. Just getting Basic Food isn't enough.

complies_with_tanf_work_requirements.description: Whether they get TANF cash assistance and are meeting its work requirements.

in_drug_or_alcohol_treatment.description: Whether they're in a drug or alcohol treatment program.

incarcerated_or_released_within_3_months.description: Whether they're in jail or prison, or were released within the last 3 months.

enrolled_in_other_apple_health_program.description: Whether they're in an Apple Health program other than Apple Health for Adults.

hardship_inpatient_care.description: Whether they spent time in a hospital, nursing home, or inpatient psychiatric care.

hardship_travel_for_medical_care.description: Whether they had to travel more than an hour from home for medical care for a serious condition, for themselves or a dependent.

hardship_disaster_area.description: Whether they live in a county under a federal disaster declaration.

hardship_high_unemployment_county.description: Whether they live in a county with very high unemployment. The state decides this; usually leave it out unless they've been told.

is_seasonal_worker.description: Whether their work is seasonal, like farm work in a growing season or retail work only during the holidays.

work_requirement.description: Exclusions and exemptions from the work requirement. Each one means "in any of the 6 months before renewal." Always send, as {} if nothing is known.

description:
What a person renewing Washington Apple Health for Adults has told us. Every field is optional: leave out anything
you don't know yet, and never send null. The graph's next_questions output says what to ask next.
Hash sections (renewer, work_requirement) should always be sent, as {} if empty. List sections (household_members,
months) should be sent only once you know what's in them, because an empty list is an answer.
Money is integer cents. Months are "YYYY-MM"; dates are "YYYY-MM-DD".
Record only what the person says; the graph applies the rules.
